# 2 Chronicles Chapter 11 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** And-he-came Rehoboam to-Jerusalem and-he-assembled house-of Judah and-Benjamin a-hundred-and-eighty thousand chosen making-war to-fight with Israel to-return the-kingdom to-Rehoboam.

**2** And-was word-of YHWH to-Shemaiah man-of God saying

**3** say to-Rehoboam son-of Solomon king-of Judah and-to all Israel in-Judah and-Benjamin saying

**4** thus says YHWH you-shall-not go-up and-not fight with your-brothers return each-man to-his-house for from-Me was-done this thing and-they-heard words-of YHWH and-they-returned from-going against Jeroboam.

**5** And-he-dwelt Rehoboam in-Jerusalem and-he-built cities for-fortification in-Judah.

**6** And-he-built Bethlehem and-Etam and-Tekoa

**7** and-Beth-zur and-Soco and-Adullam

**8** and-Gath and-Mareshah and-Ziph

**9** and-Adoraim and-Lachish and-Azekah

**10** and-Zorah and-Aijalon and-Hebron that are-in Judah and-in-Benjamin cities-of fortification.

**11** And-he-strengthened the-fortifications and-he-put in-them commanders and-stores-of food and-oil and-wine.

**12** And-in-every city and-city shields and-spears and-he-strengthened-them exceedingly great and-it-was for-him Judah and-Benjamin.

**13** And-the-priests and-the-Levites who were-in all Israel presented-themselves to-him from-all their-territory.

**14** For the-Levites left their-pasture-lands and-their-possession and-they-came to-Judah and-to-Jerusalem for rejected-them Jeroboam and-his-sons from-serving-as-priests to-YHWH.

**15** And-he-appointed for-himself priests for-the-high-places and-for-the-goat-demons and-for-the-calves that he-made.

**16** And-after-them from-all tribes-of Israel the-setting their-heart to-seek YHWH God-of Israel came to-Jerusalem to-sacrifice to-YHWH God-of their-fathers.

**17** And-they-strengthened kingdom-of Judah and-they-made-strong Rehoboam son-of Solomon for-three years for they-walked in-way-of David and-Solomon for-three years.

**18** And-he-took for-himself Rehoboam a-wife Mahalath daughter-of Jerimoth son-of David and-Abihail daughter-of Eliab son-of Jesse.

**19** And-she-bore to-him sons Jeush and-Shemariah and-Zaham.

**20** And-after-her he-took Maacah daughter-of Absalom and-she-bore to-him Abijah and-Attai and-Ziza and-Shelomith.

**21** And-he-loved Rehoboam Maacah daughter-of Absalom more-than-all his-wives and-his-concubines for wives eighteen he-took and-concubines sixty and-he-fathered sons twenty-and-eight and-daughters sixty.

**22** And-he-appointed Rehoboam as-head Abijah son-of Maacah as-leader among his-brothers for to-make-him-king.

**23** And-he-dealt-wisely and-he-spread from-all his-sons to-all lands-of Judah and-Benjamin to-all cities-of the-fortification and-he-gave to-them food for-abundance and-he-sought multitude-of wives.


---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **11:4**: from-Me was-done this thing — God claims direct responsibility for the kingdom's division. Even political catastrophe serves divine purposes.

- **11:14-15**: rejected-them Jeroboam — The northern exodus of Levites and faithful Israelites to Judah is the Chronicler's way of showing that true Israel relocated south.

- **11:23**: he-dealt-wisely — Rehoboam's distribution of his sons prevents succession crises and maintains control of fortified cities. Political wisdom despite spiritual mediocrity.


— EMET
